metrics.label: Total revenue
metrics.watch_out: A1 Austria includes roughly EUR 155mn of low-margin international transit that peers do not carry.

metrics.label: Service revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue from services, excluding equipment sales.
metrics.watch_out: Definitions differ. HT excludes System Solutions; A1 includes Solutions and Connectivity. DT does not disclose it for Austria.

metrics.label: EBITDA
metrics.definition: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation. Before lease costs.
metrics.watch_out: Not comparable with EBITDAaL. Operators that spun off towers look better on EBITDA.

metrics.label: EBITDAaL
metrics.watch_out: DT, HT and United Group all report ADJUSTED EBITDAaL with special factors removed. A1 does not adjust. Compare against A1 like-for-like where available.

metrics.label: EBIT
metrics.definition: Operating profit after depreciation and amortisation.
metrics.watch_out: Most peers do not publish EBIT per country.

metrics.label: Capex
metrics.watch_out: HT reports CAPEX AL including leases; A1 excludes them. A1 Serbia 2025 includes EUR 100mn of 5G spectrum.

metrics.label: Opex (derived)
metrics.definition: Revenue minus EBITDA. Nobody publishes opex per market, so this is derived.
metrics.watch_out: Only valid where both revenue and EBITDA come from the same basis.

metrics.label: Mobile subscribers
metrics.watch_out: A1 group subscriber growth is driven by M2M SIMs, which earn cents. Counting rules differ by operator.

metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.watch_out: Reported, not organic. FX moves affect Serbia and North Macedonia.

metrics.label: Service revenue growth
metrics.watch_out: The metric analysts anchor on. Magenta shows TOTAL revenue growth here because DT does not split it.

metrics.label: EBITDAaL growth
metrics.watch_out: Restructuring charges swing this. A1 Austria carried EUR 96mn in 2025.

metrics.label: EBITDA margin
metrics.watch_out: Use this only where a peer publishes no EBITDAaL, as with Telekom Slovenije.

metrics.label: EBITDAaL margin
metrics.definition: EBITDAaL divided by revenue. The headline profitability measure.
metrics.watch_out: A1 spun off towers in 2023, HT in Sep 2025, so lease costs sit below the line for both. Peers report ADJUSTED; A1 does not.

metrics.label: EBITDAaL margin, like-for-like
metrics.definition: A1 restated to the peer basis: restructuring added back, international transit excluded.
metrics.watch_out: THIS is the figure to compare against an adjusted peer margin. Using the reported margin overstates the gap by around 5 points in Austria.

metrics.label: EBIT margin
metrics.watch_out: A1 Slovenia is negative in both years.

metrics.label: Capex intensity
metrics.watch_out: Scored as lower-is-better, which measures capital discipline, NOT competitive position. HT spends 23.8% against A1 Croatia 13.5% and is winning the fibre build. Read this cell carefully.

metrics.label: EBITDAaL less capex margin
metrics.watch_out: The most robust single cross-operator measure on this list.

metrics.label: Mobile ARPU
metrics.definition: Monthly mobile revenue per subscriber, EUR.
metrics.watch_out: A1 STOPPED disclosing this per market from FY2025, citing competition sensitivity. HT still publishes it. No comparison is possible.
